snippet.title: Encryptid - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description: Here's your look at the Encryptid teaser trailer for this upcoming short FMV horror game about hunting and catching cryptids. Encryptid features real photography and full-motion video recorded via the Gameboy Camera. Use real-world footage recorded exclusively via the Gameboy Camera to identify, locate and battle iconic creatures of myth and folklore. Encryptid will be available on PC.
